propositions: A stale backup directory .bridge_state.bak-retarget containing 33 MB of dead files from a single static revision is materialized in every worktree checkout and must be removed from HEAD.
Fresh checkout working-tree size must shrink by at least 33 MB after deletion of the backup directory.

Removal of .bridge_state.bak-retarget must not introduce new diagnostics in rebar fsck or corrupt the store, verified by unchanged before/after diagnostic multiset and successful post-delete reconcile-check.
No production code in src/ or .github/ consumes the deleted backup directory path.
Test fixture references to the deleted backup directory name must be removed from live-Jira store-copy isolation tests while preserving glob-based scrub and fixture isolation guarantees.
